name: anvesa-workspace
description: anvesa: dense + structural code retrieval, as a set of subsystems. Self-contained so the whole directory can be extracted to its own repo.

scripts.boundaries: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs core/src syntax/src structural/src dense/src indexer/src retriever/src cli/src embedder/src eval/src
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run test
scripts.smoke: bun run tooling/smoke-package.ts && bun run tooling/smoke-npm.ts
